regime_context: The TSX detector shows Oil & Gas as the clear momentum leader (only theme with score >1) but with a mean-revert hurst tag, zero breadth, and low durability (0.41) — a concentrated, potentially fragile leadership. The absolute-trend gate is validated as risk control on this market's history (gate_helps=true), so eligible themes (Oil & Gas, Big Banks, Consumer Staples, Insurers, Utilities, Asset Mgrs, Tech) are the stay-power universe. Track record shows 55.8% hit rate but only 31.3% directional accuracy — historical high-conviction calls were often directionally wrong, so conviction defaults low across the board. No one-narrative dominance and mixed breadth-of-rotation suggests a choppy, not cleanly trending tape.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Utilities & Renewables (XUT.TO, rank 6, breadth 0.917, durability 0.81, trend hurst) overtakes Consumer Staples & Retail (XST.TO, rank 3) in rank order while XST.TO remains crowded (z=1.02) — a confirmed swap of rank position across 3 consecutive sessions would retire the watch.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the challenger in the rotation radar, ranked 2nd with a high durability bar (0.70), the strongest breadth of any eligible theme (0.714), and a mixed-to-positive hurst tag. Unlike the Oil & Gas leader (breadth 0.0, mean-revert), Banks show genuine participation across constituents — a coherent, durable leadership structure. The trend-gate eligibility means the absolute trend is intact, so the validated drawdown-control leg applies.
theses.dissent: The rotation margin between leader and challenger is only 0.46, and rotation timing has no validated forward edge — Banks could just as easily stall here while Oil & Gas consolidates and re-accelerates, or the whole tape mean-reverts.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags XEG.TO by more than 4% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the momentum leader, but its leadership quality is poor: mean-revert hurst tag, zero breadth (0.0), and the lowest durability bar among top themes (0.41). The backtest verdict says the momentum rank is not a return forecast, and the one validated edge is drawdown avoidance via trend-gate — holding this despite poor internals carries concentrated shake-out risk that the gate is supposed to avoid. Avoid expresses 'no fresh capital to this location', not a short.
theses.dissent: Reflexivity: leadership can persist far beyond what internals suggest, especially in a commodity spike regime. The detector explicitly warns against fading the leader. Oil & Gas may simply re-accelerate on a volatility event and punish avoidance.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes above its 20-day high on at least 3 of 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
